title: 11th Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/11/3/2026).
First reading of a resolution by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to gauge members' views on the removal of three Supreme Court justices based on allegations it calls baseless.

First reading of a resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem to gauge members' views on the government's decision to take a vacant plot of land out of Malé City Council's control and make it state property.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Education Act (Law No. 24/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumeedhoo MP Dr. Anara Naeem.
Finance Committee report on reviewing, under Article 102 of the Constitution, the Speaker's salary and benefits, cabinet ministers' car benefits, and island councillors' benefits.
Finance Committee report on reviewing, under Article 102 of the Constitution, the Chief Justice's salary and benefits.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to introduce resolutions on the removal of three Supreme Court justices and a Malé council land takeover, debate an Education Act amendment, and take committee reports on top officials' pay.
